scope: Development comparison on twelve previously used GuitarSet takes; not held-out performance, independent songs, full-mix accuracy, or technique classification.
trainingOverlap: GuitarSet was used in Basic Pitch training; exact checkpoint track overlap is unverified.

protocol.matching: Independent maximum one-to-one matching for each criterion and recording.
protocol.denominators: Every reference note and every prediction; no cropping, alignment, pitch filtering or deduplication.
protocol.aggregation: Sum counts across all declared recordings, then calculate precision/recall/F1; never average per-track F1.
protocol.delta: Current minus frozen baseline; negative precision/recall/F1 is listed as a regression.
protocol.inference: One probe invocation and one model pass per recording; both note decoders consume the same frames.
protocol.timing: Single host process wall time includes inference, both note decoders and output; not phone latency.
